items.story:
We raise our 2026-28E earnings estimates mainly to reflect better-than-expected top-
line growth and a smaller OPM contraction. We raise our PT from NT$144 to NT$171 
(17.0x 2027E PE, unchanged). Our multiple is similar to the peer average. The share price
might react positively to better-than-expected Q326 sales data. However, we maintain
our Sell rating as OPM pressure remains and 2027 earnings growth is likely to be muted.
